passages.title: Ukážka 1 – Tom’s new school
passages.body: Tom started at a new school in September. At first he felt nervous because he did not know anyone. On the first day, a girl called Mia showed him the library and the canteen. They both love chess, so they joined the school chess club. Now Tom meets his new friends there every Wednesday after lessons. He says that moving to a new school was scary, but it was worth it.

passages.title: Ukážka 6 – A lost dog
passages.body: Last Saturday, Emma was walking in the park when she found a small brown dog. It had no collar, so she took it home and put up posters in the neighbourhood. Two days later, an old man called. His dog, Max, had run away during a storm. He was very happy and gave Emma a box of chocolates to say thank you. Emma says that she would like to get her own dog one day.

passages.title: Ukážka 11 – A new hobby
passages.body: Last year, Peter started painting. At first, his pictures were terrible, but he kept practising every evening. After six months, a local café asked him to put some of his paintings on the wall. Now he sells a few pictures every month and uses the money to buy better paints. Peter says that patience is more important than talent.

questions.prompt: Dopíš správny tvar: She ___ (not like) coffee.
questions.explanation: Záporná veta v 3. osobe: does not + základný tvar.

questions.prompt: Dopíš sloveso v správnom tvare: Look! It ___ (rain).
questions.explanation: Look! signalizuje dej, ktorý prebieha teraz.

questions.prompt: I ___ my keys yesterday.
questions.explanation: Lose – lost – lost.

questions.prompt: Tomorrow I ___ my grandmother.
questions.explanation: Rozhodnutie alebo predpoveď o budúcnosti: will + základný tvar.

questions.prompt: Dopíš minulý čas: He ___ (write) a letter last week.
questions.explanation: Write – wrote – written.

questions.prompt: Which word is the opposite of “generous”?
questions.explanation: Generous = štedrý, mean = lakomý.

questions.prompt: I need to ___ a decision before Friday.
questions.explanation: Správne spojenie je make a decision.

questions.prompt: We arrived ___ the airport at noon.
questions.explanation: Arrive at pri menších miestach, arrive in pri mestách.

questions.prompt: ___ Sun rises in the east.
questions.explanation: Jedinečné veci majú člen the.

questions.prompt: Why did Tom feel nervous at first?
questions.explanation: V texte: he did not know anyone.

questions.prompt: What do Tom and Mia have in common?
options: They are in the same class.
questions.explanation: V texte: They both love chess.

questions.prompt: Napíš, v ktorý deň sa schádza šachový klub (jedno slovo):
questions.explanation: Klub sa schádza každú stredu.

questions.prompt: Listen! Someone ___ at the door.
questions.explanation: Dej, ktorý práve počuješ, je prítomný priebehový čas.

questions.prompt: How often ___ your sister visit you?
questions.explanation: Otázka s your sister (she) používa does.

questions.prompt: Dopíš správny tvar: Water ___ (boil) at 100 degrees.
questions.explanation: Všeobecná pravda = present simple a pri it pridáme -s.

questions.prompt: ___ you at home yesterday?
questions.explanation: S you sa v minulosti používa were.

questions.prompt: I think it ___ tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Predpoveď o budúcnosti: will + základný tvar.

questions.prompt: Dopíš minulý čas: They ___ (not come) to the party.
questions.explanation: Záporná veta v minulosti: did not + základný tvar.

questions.prompt: Which word is a fruit?
questions.explanation: Pear = hruška, ostatné sú zelenina.

questions.prompt: The opposite of “early” is ___.
questions.explanation: Early = skoro, late = neskoro.

questions.prompt: Dopíš slovo: Frozen water is ______.
questions.explanation: Ice = ľad.

questions.prompt: I am afraid ___ spiders.
questions.explanation: Afraid of = báť sa niečoho.

questions.prompt: He plays ___ guitar.
questions.explanation: Pri hudobných nástrojoch používame the: play the guitar.

questions.prompt: Doplň predložku: I am interested ___ music.
questions.explanation: Interested in = zaujímať sa o niečo.

questions.prompt: You look tired. You ___ go to bed early.
questions.explanation: Should = mal by si (rada).

questions.prompt: If you heat ice, it ___.
questions.explanation: Všeobecná pravda: if + prítomný čas, prítomný čas.

questions.prompt: Dopíš správny tvar: If it ___ (be) sunny tomorrow, we will go swimming.
questions.explanation: Po if v reálnej podmienke používame prítomný čas.

questions.prompt: Who showed Tom the library?
questions.explanation: Knižnicu mu ukázala Mia.

questions.prompt: What does Tom say about moving to a new school?
options: It was scary, but it was worth it.
questions.explanation: Bolo to strašidelné, ale oplatilo sa.

questions.prompt: Napíš, v ktorom mesiaci Tom začal v novej škole (jedno slovo):
questions.explanation: Tom začal v septembri.

questions.prompt: Have you ever ___ to London?
questions.explanation: Present perfect: have/has + 3. tvar slovesa. Be – was/were – been. Ever = niekedy v živote.

questions.prompt: I ___ in this city since I was born.
questions.explanation: Since + začiatok obdobia a dej trvá doteraz: present perfect (have lived).

questions.prompt: He ___ his homework when I called.
questions.explanation: Past continuous (was/were + -ing) opisuje dej, ktorý prebiehal v danom okamihu v minulosti.

questions.prompt: Which word means the same as “enormous”?
questions.explanation: Enormous = obrovský, rovnako ako huge. Opak: tiny = drobný.

questions.prompt: I am looking ___ my keys.
questions.explanation: Look for = hľadať, look at = pozerať sa na, look after = starať sa o.

questions.prompt: She apologised ___ being late.
questions.explanation: Apologise for = ospravedlniť sa za niečo.

questions.prompt: If you do not hurry, you ___ the train.
questions.explanation: Reálna podmienka: if + prítomný čas, will + základný tvar.

questions.prompt: Why did Emma put up posters?
options: To find the owner of the dog.
questions.explanation: Emma nechcela psa nechať, preto hľadala majiteľa.

questions.prompt: When did Max run away?
questions.explanation: V texte: „had run away during a storm“.

questions.prompt: Napíš, čo dostala Emma ako poďakovanie (jedno slovo):
questions.explanation: V texte: „a box of chocolates“.

questions.prompt: I ___ my homework yet.
questions.explanation: Yet v zápore ide s present perfect: haven’t + 3. tvar slovesa.

questions.prompt: Water ___ at 0 degrees.
questions.explanation: Všeobecná pravda: present simple, pri it pridáme -s.

questions.prompt: When I was a child, I ___ play in the garden every day.
questions.explanation: Used to + základný tvar vyjadruje zvyk v minulosti.

questions.prompt: I ___ to the shop when I met Tom.
questions.explanation: Past continuous (was + -ing) opisuje dej, ktorý práve prebiehal, keď ho niečo prerušilo.

questions.prompt: Which word is an adjective?
questions.explanation: Beautiful = krásny (prídavné meno). Beauty = krása (podstatné), beautifully = krásne (príslovka).

questions.prompt: Dopíš slovo: A place where you can borrow books is a ______.
questions.explanation: Library = knižnica. Bookshop = kníhkupectvo.

questions.prompt: She is married ___ a doctor.
questions.explanation: Be married to = byť vydatá/ženatý s niekým.

questions.prompt: There is ___ umbrella in the hall.
questions.explanation: Umbrella začína samohláskovým zvukom, preto an.

questions.prompt: You ___ better see a doctor.
questions.explanation: Had better + základný tvar = radšej by si mal (silnejšia rada).

questions.prompt: I ___ speak French when I was five.
questions.explanation: Could je minulý tvar can, vyjadruje schopnosť v minulosti.

questions.prompt: How did Peter improve?
questions.explanation: V texte: „he kept practising every evening“.

questions.prompt: What happened after six months?
options: A café asked him to show his paintings.
questions.explanation: V texte: kaviareň mu ponúkla vystaviť obrazy.

questions.prompt: Napíš, čo je podľa Petra dôležitejšie než talent (jedno slovo):
questions.explanation: V texte: „patience is more important than talent“.
